data.title: The Co-op Clipping
data.text: First, the co-op turbine on the hill broke; later, the works gas main did. The courier clipping says three turbines belonged to 640 households, and a share cost about the price of a bicycle. One Riverside schoolteacher called it a start, and said he was sick of waiting for one. Calder Energy’s risk register has its own small arithmetic: flood likelihood low, impact severe; relocation deferred, upstream spillways not company policy. The Board accepted the remaining risk. I keep the clipping beside that entry. A household bought a share; a Board accepted what the company would not pay toward. The clipping is thin newsprint, but the bicycle still fits in the margin.
